small.description: Whether to use a small pagination style (deprecated)
small.description_zh: 是否使用小型分页样式

background.description: Whether the buttons have a background color
background.description_zh: 是否为分页按钮添加背景色

:default-page-size.description: Default initial value of page size, not setting is the same as setting 10
:default-page-size.description_zh: 每页显示条目数的初始值，不设置与设置为 10 相同

:page-count.description: Total page count. Set either total or page-count and pages will be displayed; if you need page-sizes, total is required
:page-count.description_zh: 总页数，total 和 page-count 设置任意一个就可以达到显示页码的功能；如果要支持 page-sizes 的更改，则需要使用 total 属性

pager-count.description: Number of pagers. Pagination collapses when the total page count exceeds this value
pager-count.description_zh: 页码按钮的数量，当总页数超过该值时会折叠

:default-current-page.description: Default initial value of current-page, not setting is the same as setting 1
:default-current-page.description_zh: 当前页数的初始值，不设置与设置为 1 相同

layout.description: Layout of Pagination, elements separated with a comma
layout.description_zh: 组件布局，子组件名用逗号分隔

:page-sizes.description: Options of item count per page
:page-sizes.description_zh: 每页显示个数选择器的选项设置

append-size-to.description: Which element the size dropdown appends to
append-size-to.description_zh: 尺寸下拉菜单附加到的元素

popper-class.description: Custom class name for the page size Select's dropdown
popper-class.description_zh: 每页显示个数选择器的下拉框类名

prev-text.description_zh: 替代图标显示的上一页文字

prev-icon.description: Icon for the prev button, has a lower priority than prev-text
prev-icon.description_zh: 上一页按钮的图标，优先级低于 prev-text

next-text.description_zh: 替代图标显示的下一页文字

next-icon.description: Icon for the next button, has a lower priority than next-text
next-icon.description_zh: 下一页按钮的图标，优先级低于 next-text

teleported.description: Whether Pagination select dropdown is teleported to the body
teleported.description_zh: 分页选择器的下拉菜单是否传送到 body 元素

hide-on-single-page.description: Whether to hide when there's only one page

events.name: change
events.description: Triggers when current-page or page-size changes
events.description_zh: 当 current-page 或 page-size 变更时触发

events.name: prev-click
events.description: Triggers when the prev button is clicked and current page changes
events.description_zh: 用户点击上一页按钮改变当前页后触发

events.name: next-click
events.description: Triggers when the next button is clicked and current page changes
events.description_zh: 用户点击下一页按钮改变当前页后触发

slots.name: default
slots.description: Custom content. To use this, you need to declare slot in layout
slots.description_zh: 自定义内容，在 layout 中声明 slot 后才会生效
